title: Non-equilibrium fluctuations of a two-species exclusion process with slow boundary
summary: We study the non-equilibrium density fluctuations of a one-dimensional two-species symmetric simple exclusion process in contact with critical slow boundary reservoirs. The boundary rates are of order $1/n$, which leads to Robin boundary conditions at the macroscopic level. We prove that the coupled fluctuation field associated with the empirical densities of two species converges to a generalized Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process.
